name: IFGL Refractories Ltd
about: IFGL Refractories Ltd is a manufacturer of Specialized refractories and requisite operating systems for Iron and Steel Industry.[1]It is promoted by the S.K. Bajoria Group of India and Krosaki Harima Corporation of Japan, a global leader in the refractories business.[2]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
The Co.'s products include Slide Gate Systems, Purging Systems, Ladle Lining & Ladle Refractories, Tundish Furniture & Tundish Refractories, and others. [1]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 40.5%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 6.58% over last 3 years.
